The chart app has three components that use `WarningIcon`, all in order-basket item tiles. Each one renders it inside the error block when `orderBasketItem.orderError` is set, so a behaviour change in the framework's icon would show up there.

1. **Medication order basket tile** (`esm-patient-medications-app`, line 91 usage), the `OrderBasketItemTile` default export. It shows the icon beside the "ERROR" label and the error message.
2. **General order basket tile** (`esm-patient-orders-app`, line 38 usage), the `OrderBasketItemTile` component. It has the same error block.
3. **Lab order basket tile** (`esm-patient-tests-app`, line 46 usage), the `LabOrderBasketItemTile` component. It is the same pattern for lab test orders.

The framework side is `WarningIcon` in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/icons/icons.tsx` (line 848). `AllergiesIcon` is an alias of it, and `date-picker-icon.component.tsx` in the styleguide also uses it. I did not list those because they are outside the chart app. The login app's `location-picker-view.component.tsx` also uses it but is not part of the chart.
